requirements.statement: A user can sign in via SSO to access the shared todo list

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before seeing the todo list
After signing in, the user lands on the shared todo list

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can add a new todo with a short text description to the shared list

criteria.must: Submitting a todo with text adds it to the shared list
A newly added todo is visible to any other signed-in user viewing the list
Attempting to add a todo with empty text is rejected

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can view the full shared list of todos

criteria.must: The list view shows every todo on the shared list, regardless of who added it

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can mark any todo as done or back to not done

criteria.must: Marking a todo done updates its status and is reflected in the list
Marking a done todo back to not done updates its status and is reflected in the list
A completed todo remains visible in the list, shown as done, rather than disappearing
A user can toggle a todo added by a different user

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can delete any todo from the shared list

criteria.must: Deleting a todo removes it from the shared list for every user
A user can delete a todo added by a different user
